The jacaranda stands at six appearances, its most recent the school shooting's wet petal scatter, which is the third consecutive image in which it functioned as a time-marker — a use narrow enough that it should not return unless it can perform as threshold or elegy, the roles it managed earliest and best. Aftermath leads all registers at thirteen entries; menace sits at seven; defiance and suspension at five each; vigil and endurance at four each; reckoning at three with a ceiling of 1; erasure holds at two entries with floor and ceiling both at 4, still the only register that has never scored below its ceiling. The body of work is fifty-five entries deep, its methods are calcifying into reflex at the level of accident-generation as much as composition, and the next productive rupture will require building toward surprise rather than waiting for it to arrive.
